proof_boundary: This is a complete bounded heuristic ranking, not a rank or Selmer bound. Singular local fibres are mean-imputed and counted.

scoring.per_prime_standardization: center and population-standardize over good fibres of P1(F_p)
scoring.positive_control_acceptance_threshold: every disclosed fibre in top 1 percent of complete H<=10000 population
scoring.tie_breaker: mean block signal, good primes, bad primes, height, denominator, numerator
